reason: Script in a drawing's customData.generationData.html (the AI-frame field) can run when Excalidraw restores a crafted file. No fixed release exists yet (0.18.1 is the latest and is affected). In Anabasis: every drawing is cleaned before Excalidraw sees it (customData, links, and embeddable, iframe and magic-frame elements are removed; see skClean in src/app.js); Excalidraw runs only in a sandboxed frame with no origin of its own, so it can't reach the project, the page or storage; and that frame runs only the page's own scripts, by hash, so injected script and event handlers are refused. Update Excalidraw as soon as a fixed release is published.
